decision_convention.policy: Features from completed bar t are evaluated after that bar is complete; earliest entry is the next observed XAUUSD D1 bar open.
decision_convention.missing_value_policy: Do not backfill from later releases; retain missingness, staleness, and coverage fields.

sources.timestamp_evidence: reconstructed_utc_and_session_convention_supported_by_a_later_exact_MT5_history_match; the legacy tab export itself contains DATE without an explicit timezone or close timestamp
sources.availability_policy: available only after the bar is complete, represented conservatively by the next observed broker D1 bar open
sources.revision_policy: The frozen raw and canonical hashes define this research vintage; any changed broker history requires a new source ID and manifest.
sources.vintage_policy: single frozen legacy snapshot; not a contemporaneous daily vintage archive
sources.volume_semantics: <TICKVOL> mapped to broker tick volume; not centralized exchange volume; <VOL> is not spliced or used
limitations: Daily OHLC and tick volume are broker/session specific.
UTC and session metadata were reconstructed after the original export.

exposure_evidence: V3 wf_05 outer validation spans 2021-2023 for every horizon.

reasons: Not registered in the frozen baseline or immutable run identity.
